title: Antigravity format research and pinning
description: Research Antigravity's real on-disk session format on BlackbookM1. Check ~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity, ~/.gemini/antigravity, ~/.antigravity, app bundle, and any state.vscdb (VS Code-based). Record schema/field names, entry kinds, authorship semantics, and counts only — never message text. Pin injected-content shapes and authorship with evidence or clearly marked assumptions. Done when: a research comment records locations, schemas, and the counting rule.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Research complete. Verified live on BlackbookM1 (Antigravity 2.18.1 desktop + antigravity-cli); counts and schema/field names only, no message text inspected into any record.

LOCATIONS
- Desktop app data: ~/.gemini/antigravity/conversations/<conversation-uuid>.db (79 files, 352 MB) + conversation_summaries.db. ~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/ is Electron shell data only (no transcripts; no User/globalStorage state.vscdb — Antigravity IDE.app is not installed).
- CLI data: ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/conversations/<conversation-uuid>.db (37 files, 112 MB) + its own conversation_summaries.db. Same schema.

CONVERSATION DB SCHEMA (both roots)
- steps(idx INTEGER PK, step_type INT, status INT, has_subtrajectory, metadata, error_details, permissions, task_details, render_info, step_payload BLOB, step_format INT) — the conversation stream, ordered by idx.
- trajectory_meta(trajectory_id, cascade_id, trajectory_type, source) — 1 row; observed trajectory_type=4, source=1 in every file.
- gen_metadata, executor_metadata, parent_references, trajectory_metadata_blob, battle_mode_infos (all empty in corpus).
- step_payload is PROTOBUF with no shipped schema (desktop app bundle has none — @bufbuild/protobuf shell only; payloads written by the backend). Decoded structurally (all 33,582 steps across both roots parse cleanly).

conversation_summaries.db columns: conversation_id, title, preview, step_count, last_modified_time, workspace_uris, status, source, project_id, agent_name, parent_conversation_id, nesting_depth, battle_id, winning_conversation_id, not_fully_idle, killed, last_user_input_time, last_user_input_step_index, app_data_dir, raw_summary, group_id.

STEP-TYPE DISTRIBUTION (desktop, 33,582 steps): 15 = 16,234 (agent narration), 132 = 15,280 (agent tool-call turns incl. run_command), 14 = 503 (USER TURNS), 101 = 1,110, 17 = 286, 23 = 150 (conversation summaries), 0 = 19.

AUTHORSHIP / COUNTING RULE (evidence + marked assumption)
- step_type 14 = the human turn. The user text sits at payload field path r.19.2 (verified: r.19.3 is a parts list whose r.19.3.1 entries CONCATENATE to r.19.2 — e.g. 176+1+1+154 = 332 chars — so count r.19.2 only; r.19.3/r.19.3.1 must be skipped or we double-count).
- 37 of 503 type-14 steps have NO r.19.2: they carry r.19.7 { r.19.7.1 = file:// URI } instead — artifact/plan attach sends (UI action, not typed text). Skip.
- Other types are agent output or records: 15/132/23/101/17 all skipped.
- Per-step timestamps: payload r.5.1.1 (epoch seconds) + r.5.1.2 (nanos).
ASSUMPTION (marked): top-level conversations' type-14 messages are human-typed (all 62 first-messages in top desktop conversations and 37/37 CLI conversations are conversational dispatch text, none matching delegation shapes); probe tokens land in r.19.2 as expected.
- Nested sub-cascades: 55/79 desktop conversations have parent_conversation_id !=  in summaries — their type-14 initial messages are agent-authored dispatch prompts (27/55 sampled start with You are tasked with/You are in PLANNING mode delegation shapes; top-level: 0/62). EXCLUDE conversations whose summary row has parent_conversation_id !=  (mirrors the Cursor subagent rule). CLI store has no nesting.
- Battle mode (battle_id) and killed flags exist but are all-empty/unused in this corpus.

EXPECTED YIELD: desktop top-level 448 type-14 steps (503 - 55 nested) minus ~37 no-text + CLI 37 = roughly 448 human messages. Attribution: conversation_summaries.workspace_uris for projectPath (39 cli summary rows have empty workspace_uris — fall back to empty). NOTE: cli summaries hold 61 rows for 37 files (stale rows) — join only on existing files.

PRIVACY: all numbers above are counts; no text recorded.
